lines.zh: 低着头往前走，肩膀一沉一沉。
lines.en: Head low, it walks with its shoulders rolling.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩在雪上，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: Its hooves press the snow with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 一大群走过，草被压出一条路。
lines.en: The herd passes and leaves a path pressed into the grass.

lines.zh: 它贴着同伴的侧腹走，保持队形。
lines.en: It walks close to a companion's flank, holding the line.

lines.zh: 长毛在腿边甩来甩去，沾满雪。
lines.en: The long hair swings at its legs, heavy with snow.

lines.zh: 每走十几步，它就要喷一口气。
lines.en: Every dozen steps it blows out a breath.

lines.zh: 背上的隆起在草丛里起起伏伏。
lines.en: The hump on its back rises and falls through the grass.

lines.zh: 它绕过泥坑，蹄子在边缘试了试。
lines.en: It goes around a mud hole after testing the edge with a hoof.

lines.zh: 走路时尾巴甩着，赶得蝇子乱飞。
lines.en: Its tail swings as it walks and scatters the flies.

lines.zh: 一头野牛慢慢挪到队伍后面。
lines.en: One bison drifts to the back of the line.

lines.zh: 蹄印又深又圆，踩得草根都断了。
lines.en: The hoofprints are deep and round, breaking the grass roots.

lines.zh: 它顺着风向走，鼻子里全是草味。
lines.en: It walks with the wind, nostrils full of grass.

lines.zh: 蹄声轻快，踏过草地。
lines.en: Hooves hit the grass, a light tread.

lines.zh: 吃草不停，咀嚼间歇。
lines.en: Chewing between bites of grass.

lines.zh: 缓缓前行，寻找食物。
lines.en: Moving slowly, seeking food.

lines.zh: 低头觅食，四处张望。
lines.en: Lowering head to eat, looking around.

lines.zh: 悠闲踱步，享受阳光。
lines.en: Walking leisurely, basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 草原漫步，脚步轻盈。
lines.en: Circling the plains, steps light.

lines.zh: 闻闻空气，草香四溢。
lines.en: Sniffing the air, grassy scents abound.

lines.zh: 踱步草原，自由自在。
lines.en: Wandering the plains, free and easy.

lines.zh: 缓慢行走，草叶轻摇。
lines.en: Walking slowly, grass swaying.

lines.zh: 享受自然，无忧无虑。
lines.en: Enjoying nature, carefree and free.

lines.zh: 厚重的肩峰随步伐起伏
lines.en: Its heavy hump rolls with each step.

lines.zh: 牛蹄踩实雪面慢慢前行
lines.en: Its hooves pack the snow as it plods on.

lines.zh: 站着吃草，嚼得很慢很响。
lines.en: It grazes standing, chewing slowly and loudly.

lines.zh: 用角蹭树干，把痒处磨了又磨。
lines.en: It rubs its horns on a trunk, working at an itch.

lines.zh: 卧在草甸上，反刍时下巴一直在动。
lines.en: Lying in the meadow, its jaw moves as it chews its cud.

lines.zh: 鼻息在冷空气里结成一团白。
lines.en: Its breath makes a white cloud in the cold air.

lines.zh: 它半闭着眼，尾巴慢慢赶苍蝇。
lines.en: Half asleep, its tail slowly swishes at the flies.

lines.zh: 靠着一块石头蹭背，石头都晃了。
lines.en: It scratches its back on a boulder and the boulder shifts.

lines.zh: 一群野牛围成半圈，谁也不说话。
lines.en: The herd stands in a loose half circle, none of them saying anything.

lines.zh: 它低头舔雪，舌头在雪面留下一道沟。
lines.en: It licks the snow and its tongue leaves a groove.

lines.zh: 肩上落了几只鸟，它也懒得管。
lines.en: Birds settle on its shoulders and it cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 它把脸埋进草丛，只露出两只角。
lines.en: It buries its face in the grass with only the horns showing.

lines.zh: 风吹动背上的长毛，像一片麦浪。
lines.en: Wind moves the long hair on its back like a field of wheat.

lines.zh: 它重重地呼出一口气，草叶都歪了。
lines.en: It huffs out hard enough to bend the grass blades.

lines.zh: 站着打盹，四条腿纹丝不动。
lines.en: It dozes on its feet without shifting a leg.

lines.zh: 它慢慢转头，把整片平原看了一遍。
lines.en: It turns its head slowly across the whole plain.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱开雪，找底下的草。
lines.en: I push the snow aside with my nose to find grass.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，把脸上的雪抖掉。
lines.en: I shake my head to throw the snow off my face.

lines.zh: 小牛在边上闹，我懒得管它。
lines.en: The calf is fussing nearby; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，整群都抬头。
lines.en: I snort, and the whole herd looks up.

lines.zh: 低头啃草，心满意足。
lines.en: Chewing grass, contented.

lines.zh: 悠闲站立，享受时光。
lines.en: Standing relaxed, savoring the moment.

lines.zh: 草地上打滚，舒展筋骨。
lines.en: Rolling in the grass, stretching.

lines.zh: 悠闲站立，沐浴阳光。
lines.en: Standing relaxed, basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 低头咀嚼，品味草香。
lines.en: Chewing, savoring the grassy taste.

lines.zh: 悠闲漫步，四处闲逛。
lines.en: Wandering around, relaxed.

lines.zh: 躺在草地上，惬意地享受。
lines.en: Lying on the grass, enjoying contentedly.

lines.zh: 静立原地，观察环境。
lines.en: Standing still, observing the surroundings.

lines.zh: 享受平静，悠闲自得。
lines.en: Enjoying peace, relaxed and content.

lines.zh: 低头觅食，草香四溢。
lines.en: Lowering head, grassy scents abound.

lines.zh: 它用角蹭着树干
lines.en: It rubs its horns against a trunk.

lines.zh: 它低头啃带霜的草
lines.en: It grazes on frost-tipped grass.

lines.zh: 鼻孔喷出两团白气
lines.en: Two plumes of white breath leave its nostrils.

lines.zh: 它站在风里一动不动
lines.en: It stands still in the wind.

lines.zh: 厚毛上结了一层薄霜
lines.en: A thin frost crusts its shaggy coat.

lines.zh: 它甩头赶走一只苍蝇
lines.en: It flicks its head to drive off a fly.

lines.zh: 它贴着同伴取暖
lines.en: It presses against the herd for warmth.

lines.zh: 它卧在草甸里反刍
lines.en: It lies in the meadow, chewing its cud.

lines.zh: 它把头顶低下来，正好对着你。
lines.en: It lowers its head until the crown points at you.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛很小，却盯得很紧。
lines.en: The eyes are small but they do not let go of you.

lines.zh: 先闻了闻你的手，再闻你的肩。
lines.en: It sniffs your hand, then your shoulder.

lines.zh: 它用角尖轻轻碰了碰你的背包。
lines.en: It taps your pack lightly with a horn tip.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，它喷了一口气。
lines.en: You are standing too close and it snorts at you.

lines.zh: 它侧头看你，像在算你有多重。
lines.en: It studies you sideways, reckoning your weight.

lines.zh: 目光从你脸上移到你的靴子。
lines.en: Its gaze slides from your face down to your boots.

lines.zh: 它不叫，只是把前蹄抬了一寸。
lines.en: It makes no sound, only lifting a forehoof an inch.

lines.zh: 你看它时，它已经在看你了。
lines.en: When you look, it is already looking.

lines.zh: 它认出你不是草料，就没兴趣了。
lines.en: It decides you are not forage and loses interest.

lines.zh: 那头野牛盯了你很久才眨眼。
lines.en: The bison holds your eyes a long time before blinking.

lines.zh: 它把头偏开，算是给了一次机会。
lines.en: It turns its head aside, which counts as one chance given.

lines.zh: 抬眼望见，玩家靠近。
lines.en: Eyes lift, seeing players approach.

lines.zh: 警觉地注视，玩家现身。
lines.en: Nervously looking, players appear.

lines.zh: 牛群在我身后，慢慢围过来。
lines.en: The herd behind me slowly closes in.

lines.zh: 警惕地观察，玩家进入视野。
lines.en: Alertly observing, players in sight.

lines.zh: 留意玩家，保持警觉。
lines.en: Noticing players, staying alert.

lines.zh: 我低头，鼻息在雪上吹出两个洞。
lines.en: Head down, my breath drills two holes in the snow.

lines.zh: 观察玩家，警惕不减。
lines.en: Observing players, vigilance unwavering.

lines.zh: 审视玩家，小心谨慎。
lines.en: Examining players, cautious and watchful.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，保持警惕。
lines.en: Staring at players, alert and wary.

lines.zh: 整群牛都盯着你，别乱动。
lines.en: The whole herd is watching, so hold still.

lines.zh: 它抬头，把角对着你
lines.en: It raises its head, horns toward you.

lines.zh: 它从草里看你，没有动
lines.en: It watches you from the grass without moving.

lines.zh: 它猛地转身，角差点扫到你。
lines.en: It whirls around and a horn nearly catches you.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，它把身子压低再撞。
lines.en: Struck, it lowers itself and charges again.

lines.zh: 那声怒吼把附近的鸟都惊飞了。
lines.en: The roar sends every nearby bird up.

lines.zh: 它背上皮厚，伤口只渗出一点血。
lines.en: Its hide is thick and the wound only seeps.

lines.zh: 它退了两步，蹄子刨出两道沟。
lines.en: It backs two steps and its hooves gouge two lines.

lines.zh: 它甩了甩头，把痛感甩掉。
lines.en: It shakes its head to throw the pain off.

lines.zh: 受伤后它不再退，站得更稳了。
lines.en: Hurt, it stops retreating and stands firmer.

lines.zh: 一记挨打，它记住了是谁动的手。
lines.en: After taking the blow, it remembers whose hand it was.

lines.zh: 它把牛群挡在身后，自己面对你。
lines.en: It puts the herd behind it and faces you alone.

lines.zh: 长毛底下流了点血，它不当回事。
lines.en: A little blood under the long hair and it pays it no mind.

lines.zh: 这一下撞在我厚厚的肩上了。
lines.en: That blow landed on my thick shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的后腿一软，差点跪下。
lines.en: My hind leg buckles and I nearly kneel.

lines.zh: 哎呀，翅膀受伤了。
lines.en: My wings are hurt.

lines.zh: 身上有些伤口。
lines.en: I have some wounds.

lines.zh: 肚子疼，受伤了。
lines.en: My stomach hurts.

lines.zh: 脚伤得很严重。
lines.en: My foot is badly injured.

lines.zh: 我的肩胛被顶得生疼。
lines.en: My shoulder aches from the blow.

lines.zh: 风雪里的厚毛，也挡不住这一下。
lines.en: Even this winter coat can't stop that.

lines.zh: 身上有伤口。
lines.en: I have wounds.

lines.zh: 平原上的这群牛，背都厚。
lines.en: Every bison on this plain has a thick back.

lines.zh: 闻到干草味，它把鼻子伸得很长。
lines.en: Smelling hay, it stretches its nose out far.

lines.zh: 一把草料就能把它从群里引出来。
lines.en: A handful of hay will draw it out of the herd.

lines.zh: 它试探着咬了一口，又抬头看你。
lines.en: It takes a testing bite, then looks up at you.

lines.zh: 它跟着你走，蹄子踩得很响。
lines.en: It follows you with hooves landing loudly.

lines.zh: 你把草举高，它就抬起了头。
lines.en: Raise the grass and it lifts its head.

lines.zh: 那头野牛为了草，肯让人摸脖子。
lines.en: For grass, that bison will let you touch its neck.

lines.zh: 它一边吃一边喷气，草屑乱飞。
lines.en: It eats and snorts at the same time, scattering chaff.

lines.zh: 它闻了闻你空着的手，很失望。
lines.en: It sniffs your empty hand and is clearly disappointed.

lines.zh: 一点草料让它的脾气软了下来。
lines.en: A little forage softens its temper.

lines.zh: 它慢慢靠近，先伸舌头再伸嘴。
lines.en: It approaches slowly, tongue first, mouth after.

lines.zh: 哞哞叫着吸引你注意
lines.en: Moo to catch your attention

lines.zh: 低头寻找新鲜的草叶
lines.en: Lower head to graze on fresh grass

lines.zh: 用角轻触求友
lines.en: Butterfly with horns to mate

lines.zh: 警惕地嗅着周围的空气
lines.en: Sniff the air cautiously

lines.zh: 用蹄子在地上刨出嫩芽
lines.en: Nuzzle the ground for tender shoots

lines.zh: 你手里的草，让我停下脚步。
lines.en: The grass in your hand makes me stop.

lines.zh: 对着你发出温柔的哞声
lines.en: 发出温柔的 moo

lines.zh: 在草地上寻找美味的草籽
lines.en: Search for tasty seeds on the grass

lines.zh: 用眼神邀请你接近
lines.en: Invite you with a gaze

lines.zh: 用鼻子轻轻地触碰你
lines.en: Nudge you gently with its nose

lines.zh: 它一顶，你整个人向后滑了两步。
lines.en: One butt and you slide back two paces.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞上来，像撞到一堵墙。
lines.en: Its shoulder hits like a wall.

lines.zh: 你被它的角挑了一下，鞋都歪了。
lines.en: A horn catches you and your boot twists.

lines.zh: 它只是走过去，顺手把你挤开。
lines.en: It merely walks past and shoulders you out of the way.

lines.zh: 撞完它回头看了一眼，很不耐烦。
lines.en: After the hit it glances back, thoroughly impatient.

lines.zh: 那一身毛擦过你，扎得很。
lines.en: That coat of hair brushes you and it prickles.

lines.zh: 它用额头顶住你，往前推。
lines.en: It presses its forehead to you and pushes forward.

lines.zh: 它蹄子踩在你脚边，土都陷下去。
lines.en: Its hoof lands beside your foot and the soil sinks.

lines.zh: 你被撞得转了半圈，它已经走了。
lines.en: You spin half around and it has already moved on.

lines.zh: 一群野牛挤过来，你只能后退。
lines.en: The herd crowds through and you can only back away.

lines.zh: 突然冲撞你以示警告
lines.en: Charge to warn you

lines.zh: 用角猛烈撞击障碍物
lines.en: Butter with force

lines.zh: 用蹄子踢打敌人
lines.en: Kick with hooves

lines.zh: 用角猛烈撞击你的头部
lines.en: Charge your head with horns

lines.zh: 用力顶撞附近的树干
lines.en: Butter the tree trunk hard

lines.zh: 用蹄子踢打入侵者
lines.en: Stomp the intruder with hooves

lines.zh: 用角猛烈撞击你的胸膛
lines.en: Charge your chest with horns

lines.zh: 用蹄子踢打附近的岩石
lines.en: Stomp nearby rocks with hooves

lines.zh: 用角猛烈撞击你的腹部
lines.en: Charge your abdomen with horns

lines.zh: 用蹄子踢打敌人的腿
lines.en: Stomp the enemy's legs with hooves

lines.zh: 两头野牛把头低下来，角对在一起。
lines.en: Two bison lower their heads, horns meeting.

lines.zh: 它们互相蹭脸，毛都蹭乱了。
lines.en: They rub faces until the hair is a mess.

lines.zh: 一头绕着另一头走，蹄子刨着土。
lines.en: One circles the other, pawing at the dirt.

lines.zh: 低沉的吼声从胸腔里滚出来。
lines.en: A low bellow rolls up from the chest.

lines.zh: 它们并肩站着，头朝同一个方向。
lines.en: They stand shoulder to shoulder, heads the same way.

lines.zh: 它替伴侣舔了舔颈侧的毛。
lines.en: It licks the hair along its partner's neck.

lines.zh: 两头一起刨地，雪被扬到身后。
lines.en: Both paw the ground and throw snow behind them.

lines.zh: 蹭角的时候，两只都很小心。
lines.en: When their horns touch, both are careful.

lines.zh: 它们带着小牛走在外侧，挡着风。
lines.en: They walk the calf on the outside, blocking the wind.

lines.zh: 叫声一应一和，传过整片平原。
lines.en: Their calls answer each other across the plain.

lines.zh: 用角轻轻触碰对方
lines.en: Butter the other with horns

lines.zh: 用鼻子互相触碰
lines.en: Nuzzle each other with noses

lines.zh: 用舌头舔对方
lines.en: Lick each other with tongues

lines.zh: 用角轻轻碰撞
lines.en: Butter each other with horns gently

lines.zh: 用鼻子相互轻嗅
lines.en: Sniff each other with noses gently

lines.zh: 用舌头轻轻舔舐
lines.en: Lick each other gently with tongues

lines.zh: 用角互相摩擦
lines.en: Butter each other with horns

lines.zh: 用鼻子互相亲吻
lines.en: Kiss each other with noses

lines.zh: 用舌头轻轻舔吻
lines.en: Lick each other gently

lines.zh: 用鼻子互相轻触
lines.en: Nuzzle each other gently

lines.zh: 它低头叼起地上的东西，甩了甩。
lines.en: It picks the thing up and gives it a shake.

lines.zh: 用角把包裹挑起来，翻了个面。
lines.en: It flips the bundle over with a horn.

lines.zh: 它闻了闻，觉得不能吃，放下了。
lines.en: It sniffs, decides it is not food, and drops it.

lines.zh: 那么重的东西，它一顶就挪开了。
lines.en: Something that heavy, it moves aside with one push.

lines.zh: 它把草束叼在嘴里，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: It takes a bundle of grass in its mouth and chews.

lines.zh: 角上挂着你的绳子，它没察觉。
lines.en: Your rope is caught on its horn and it has not noticed.

lines.zh: 它试着用舌头卷起来，没卷动。
lines.en: It tries to curl its tongue around it and fails.

lines.zh: 它把东西推到同伴面前，像在分享。
lines.en: It shoves the thing toward a companion, as if sharing.

lines.zh: 叼起来又放下，反复了三次。
lines.en: It picks it up and puts it down, three times over.

lines.zh: 它对东西没兴趣，只踩了一脚。
lines.en: It has no interest in your things and merely steps on them.

lines.zh: 嗷！”，你拾起了我的同伴。
lines.en: Aaah! You picked up my companion.

lines.zh: 哞哞哞！”，我被你拾起来了。
lines.en: Moo moo moo! I’m picked up by you.

lines.zh: 不！”，不要碰我！
lines.en: No! Don’t touch me!

lines.zh: 别动我！”，警告声。
lines.en: Don’t move me! Warning.

lines.zh: 呼——”，我被你带走了。
lines.en: Huff—, I’m carried away.

lines.zh: 呼呼呼！”，我喘着粗气。
lines.en: Huff huff huff! I’m puffing.

lines.zh: 别！”，我还没准备好！
lines.en: No! I’m not ready yet!

lines.zh: 不！”，让我去吃草！
lines.en: No! Let me go eat grass!

lines.zh: 呼呼呼！”，我的呼吸声。
lines.en: Huff huff huff! My breathing.

lines.zh: 哞哞哞！”，我被你拉走。
lines.en: Moo moo moo! I’m dragged by you.

lines.zh: 前蹄刨地，土块被踢到身后。
lines.en: A forehoof paws the ground and clods fly back.

lines.zh: 它把头压到膝盖那么低。
lines.en: It drops its head as low as its knees.

lines.zh: 鼻孔张得很大，喷出两道白气。
lines.en: Its nostrils flare and shoot two white jets of breath.

lines.zh: 它侧过身，把角对准了你。
lines.en: It turns broadside and points a horn at you.

lines.zh: 背上的隆起绷紧了，步子开始变快。
lines.en: The hump tightens and its pace quickens.

lines.zh: 它先叫了一声，算是最后一次提醒。
lines.en: It calls once, which is the final warning.

lines.zh: 蹄子在地上一顿，整头牛都沉下去。
lines.en: A hoof stamps and the whole animal settles lower.

lines.zh: 它开始小跑，草被踩得倒向两边。
lines.en: It breaks into a trot and the grass bends away.

lines.zh: 同伴往旁边让开，给它腾出地方。
lines.en: The herd steps aside to give it room.

lines.zh: 目标进了它的地盘，它不再吃草。
lines.en: The target is on its ground and it stops grazing.

lines.zh: 哞——”，我闻到了你的气味。
lines.en: Moo—, I smell you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，锁定目标。
lines.en: Hisss! Target acquired.

lines.zh: 嗷——”，我准备好了！
lines.en: Aaah—, I’m ready!

lines.zh: 哞哞哞！”，我注意到了你。
lines.en: Moo moo moo! I notice you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，锁定目标！
lines.en: Hisss! Target acquired!

lines.zh: 嗷——”，我要开始追踪你了。
lines.en: Aaah—, I’m tracking you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，我盯上你了。
lines.en: Hisss! I’m on you.

lines.zh: 嗷——”，我要找到你！
lines.en: Aaah—, I’m finding you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，注意我的逼近。
lines.en: Hisss! Watch my approach.

lines.zh: 哞哞哞！”，我的视线锁定你。
lines.en: Moo moo moo! My sight’s on you.

lines.zh: 它绕着你走，蹄子一直没停。
lines.en: It circles you without letting its hooves rest.

lines.zh: 每绕半圈，它就低一次头。
lines.en: Every half circle it dips its head once.

lines.zh: 它不急着撞，先把你困在空地上。
lines.en: It does not rush, first herding you into the open.

lines.zh: 角尖随着你的动作慢慢转。
lines.en: The horn tip tracks your movements slowly.

lines.zh: 它挡住你和牛群之间的路。
lines.en: It plants itself between you and the herd.

lines.zh: 呼吸越来越粗，雪都被吹化了。
lines.en: Its breathing grows rough enough to melt the snow.

lines.zh: 它选好了角度，退后半步蓄力。
lines.en: It picks the angle and backs half a step to gather itself.

lines.zh: 尾巴竖起来，像一根旗杆。
lines.en: Its tail goes up like a flagpole.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的膝弯，那里最好顶。
lines.en: It fixes on the back of your knees, easiest to hit.

lines.zh: 四周的野牛都停下来看。
lines.en: The bison around all stop to watch.

lines.zh: 哞——”，我要攻击你！
lines.en: Moo—, I’m attacking you!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，我要攻击你！
lines.en: Hisss! I’m attacking you!

lines.zh: 嗷——”，我要吃了你！
lines.en: Aaah—, I’m gonna eat you!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，我要吃了你！
lines.en: Hisss! I’m gonna eat you!

lines.zh: 哞哞哞！”，我的獠牙准备好了。
lines.en: Moo moo moo! My fangs are ready.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，我准备咬你！
lines.en: Hisss! I’m gonna bite you!

lines.zh: 嗷——”，我要用角顶你！
lines.en: Aaah—, I’m gonna use my horns!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，我准备用角顶你！
lines.en: Hisss! I’m gonna use my horns!

lines.zh: 哞哞哞！”，我饿了，准备攻击！
lines.en: Moo moo moo! I’m hungry, attacking!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，我饿了，准备攻击！
lines.en: Hisss! I’m hungry, attacking!

lines.zh: 一角顶上来，你整个人飞离地面。
lines.en: A horn comes up and lifts you clean off the ground.

lines.zh: 它歪头一挑，把你甩到半空。
lines.en: It hooks sideways and tosses you into the air.

lines.zh: 额头撞在你胸口，声音很闷。
lines.en: Its forehead hits your chest with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 蹄子踏下来，地面都凹了一块。
lines.en: A hoof comes down and the ground dents.

lines.zh: 它撞完不收势，直接冲过去。
lines.en: It does not stop after the hit but charges through.

lines.zh: 角尖擦过护甲，留下一道白印。
lines.en: The horn scrapes your armor and leaves a white mark.

lines.zh: 那一顶把你送进了灌木丛。
lines.en: That butt sends you into the bushes.

lines.zh: 它转身时后蹄还在踢。
lines.en: Even as it turns, a hind hoof is still kicking.

lines.zh: 冲撞的余势把草压平了一整片。
lines.en: The charge's momentum flattens a whole patch of grass.

lines.zh: 它撞一下就走开，好像只是路过。
lines.en: It delivers one hit and walks off as if just passing by.

lines.zh: 哞哞叫着向前冲
lines.en: Baa and charge

lines.zh: 用角顶撞你
lines.en: Butt you with horns

lines.zh: 咆哮着踢你一脚
lines.en: Stomp on you with a roar

lines.zh: 用蹄子猛踩
lines.en: Stomp with hooves

lines.zh: 怒吼着撞向你
lines.en: Charge with a roar

lines.zh: 用角撞你
lines.en: Butt you with horns

lines.zh: 用力撞击你
lines.en: Ram into you

lines.zh: 用蹄子踢你
lines.en: Kick with hooves

lines.zh: 愤怒地冲撞你
lines.en: Butt aggressively

lines.zh: 用角攻击你
lines.en: Butt attack you

lines.zh: 平原尽头出现一群黑色的背脊。
lines.en: A line of dark backs appears at the end of the plain.

lines.zh: 雪原上多了一头低头吃草的野牛。
lines.en: A grazing bison has appeared on the snowfield.

lines.zh: 它从坡下走上来，身上还挂着霜。
lines.en: It comes up the slope with frost still on its coat.

lines.zh: 蹄声先到，牛群才从雾里出来。
lines.en: The hooves come first and the herd walks out of the mist.

lines.zh: 一头野牛站在草甸中间，慢慢嚼着。
lines.en: A bison stands in the meadow, slowly chewing.

lines.zh: 它喷出一口白气，宣布自己到了。
lines.en: It blows out a white breath to announce its arrival.

lines.zh: 这头牛是跟着草味一路找来的。
lines.en: This one followed the smell of grass all the way here.

lines.zh: 长毛上结了薄冰，走起来叮叮响。
lines.en: Thin ice on its coat tinkles as it walks.

lines.zh: 它找了块空地，开始刨雪找草。
lines.en: It finds open ground and starts pawing through snow for grass.

lines.zh: 远处传来一声低吼，牛群应了。
lines.en: A low bellow comes from afar and the herd answers.

lines.zh: 它站在风口，替后面挡着风。
lines.en: It stands at the wind's mouth, blocking it for those behind.

lines.zh: 新来的这头牛很壮，角也很完整。
lines.en: The newcomer is strong, with a full pair of horns.

lines.zh: 从远处的草原出现
lines.en: Spawn from distant grasslands

lines.zh: 在平原上出生
lines.en: Spawn on plains

lines.zh: 从草甸中走出
lines.en: Walk out from fells

lines.zh: 从雪地平原中出现
lines.en: Spawn in snowy plains

lines.zh: 从地面上冒出
lines.en: Pop out from ground

lines.zh: 从草地上冒出
lines.en: Pop up from grass

lines.zh: 在平原边缘现身
lines.en: Spawn at plains edge

lines.zh: 从远方的平原出现
lines.en: Spawn from faraway plains

lines.zh: 在草地上生长
lines.en: Spawn on grass

lines.zh: 在平原上诞生
lines.en: Spawn in plains

lines.zh: 牛群从雪原尽头走来
lines.en: The herd comes over the far edge of the snowfield.

lines.zh: 草甸上多了一头小牛
lines.en: A calf stands new in the meadow.

lines.zh: 毛被烧焦一片，它疯了一样打转。
lines.en: A patch of hair burns and it spins like mad.

lines.zh: 雪原的毛被燎出一股焦味。
lines.en: My snowfield coat reeks of singed hair.

lines.zh: 落地时四条腿一齐撑住，没倒。
lines.en: It lands on all four legs at once and stays up.

lines.zh: 我滑下斜坡，四蹄打滑。
lines.en: I slide down the slope, hooves scrabbling.

lines.zh: 它鼻口露出水面，拼命往浅处走。
lines.en: Its muzzle above water, it fights toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 水里游不动，我的蹄子太沉。
lines.en: I cannot swim; my hooves are too heavy.

lines.zh: 冲击把它推开几步，它硬撑着没跪。
lines.en: The blast shoves it back several steps and it refuses to kneel.

lines.zh: 气浪撞在牛角上，我发懵。
lines.en: The blast hits my horns and stuns me.

lines.zh: 箭扎进厚皮，只进去一半。
lines.en: The arrow sinks into the thick hide only halfway.

lines.zh: 箭扎进厚毛，扎得挺深。
lines.en: The arrow went deep into my thick coat.

lines.zh: 它对着空处甩头，不明白哪来的痛。
lines.en: It shakes its head at empty air, puzzled by the pain.

lines.zh: 毛上冒出奇怪的火花。
lines.en: Odd sparks crawl through my fur.

lines.zh: 雪盖得太厚，它只能刨出几根枯草。
lines.en: Snow lies too deep and it can only scrape up a few dry stems.

lines.zh: 我饿得不行，草甸上没剩几口草。
lines.en: Starving; barely a mouthful of grass left on the meadow.

lines.zh: 雷落下，它全身一抖，角尖发亮。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and it shudders, horn tips glowing.

lines.zh: 雷落在牛背上，我差点倒地。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I nearly drop.

lines.zh: 它在空处刨着蹄子，找不到着力点。
lines.en: It paws at nothing without finding ground.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚无里了！
lines.en: I fell into the void!
